body:
### UTC Date & Time

[May 28, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/may-28-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

glamsterdam-devnet-4:
- Launched since the last ACD. The network seems broken, what's the status there? 
- Target gas limit moved to CL via `prepare_payload` has been merged in both the exec API and consensus specs
- Builder deposit overflow capped at 190M for Glamsterdam testing. Has anyone done more deposit benchmark tests?

generic Glamsterdam:
- Produce block v4 with payload: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/580
- SSZ engineAPI — both Barnabas (REST/SSZ, 5–10x speedup) and Marius (full refactor) prototypes under review. Can we make a final architectural decision? ([https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/764](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/764)) vs ([https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793))

glamsterdam-devnet-5 timeline? I'd want to first have a stable devnet before we add more features into it.

Hegota:
- EIP-7684: Return deposits for distinct credentials (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7684)
- EIP-8148: Custom sweep threshold for validators (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148)
- EIP-8243: # Batching Attestations at Source (github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11589)

comments.body: I'd love to do a short presentation and Q&A on this EIP as a non-headliner candidate for Hegotá: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11589

I would like to propose for inclusion for Hegota [EIP-8148](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148) (was in agenda in last ACDC but did not get time). 

[Slides](https://pitch.com/v/eip-8148-acdc-z4w5ev) 
[Thread in Magicians]( https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8148-custom-sweep-threshold-for-validators/27669) 
[PR on Hegota Meta-EIP](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11508)

Couple of weeks ago there were some discussions about possibly shifting the ACDC schedule from 14:00 UTC to an alternative time, when it's more suitable for Asia/Australia Time Zone. 
After having an internal poll about it with the CL devs, I'd like to officially propose the shift from 14:00 UTC -> 11:00 UTC.
Update on my end: I'll need to postpone the EIP-8243 presentation to the next ACDC.

> propose for inclusion for Hegota [EIP-8148](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148)

@gkoumout can you please share the slides for your presentation
